notes.title: Beta Update - Melee Combat + Sandbox!
notes.content:
Yep, it’s another one of those “Old Kingdom’s Pandemic Updates”™! This time we are focusing on two major parts of the game - Melee Combat and Sandbox. Both of these vital elements have received some pretty big overhauls. Let’s check them out!

New Melee Attacks
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/7756407f0b9fa8ac04c8f80828e74400e7cb096b.gif

Now you will have even more ways of slaying your enemies! Powerful new moves such as: Axe Throw, Flying Dagger or Furious Spin will surely become nice additions to your character’s moveset. After all, if you have to defeat them you might as well do it in style, right?

New Melee Talent Trees
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/f0b0db784136d4723fa55746c50d63aadb224cd1.gif

Melee overhaul is not only about adding new moves. In fact, the main goal was to rebuild the whole melee combat system from the ground up. This is the result - a whole bunch of new melee oriented talent trees filled with exciting new abilities for you to choose from and mix-and-match!

New Cave Visuals
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/3caa63e38099948ba40191cd862a5e6cbc53c1d4.gif

It’s time for us to go DEEP! Underground even! How come that only surface level visuals are unique to every province (you might ask)? Well… not anymore! Now you can also enjoy the pristine new visuals of cave systems that are indeed unique for every available province. Moreover, each cave system will have its unique set of monsters!

New NPC Sandbox Encounters
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/729807f34af1590f4a7ff7c80fc01eb7be056f34.gif

Who’s that figure on the horizon? Friend or foe? What’s their business? In order to enrich your roleplaying experience we added some unique, randomly generated NPC encounters that might appear throughout all sandbox locations. You will be able to talk to them and e.g. deepen your knowledge about the Old Kingdom’s lore!

notes.title: Beta Update - Frostpath, Drysoil and updated biomes are here!
notes.content:
Time for another “Old Kingdom’s Pandemic Update”™! The things are pretty good, we seem to be handling the situation rather well. So much so that the King announced the opening of borders with the next provinces! That’s right - Frostpath and Drysoil are now open!!!


Frostpath Province
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/0763ff573ca366fa77c3eaba2e3d9b9c41f5f5d9.gif

Visit the winter, ever-frozen landscape of Frostpath. This icy realm is a home to tribes of dwarfs and nords. However, do watch out… the ice can be pretty thin in many places. If you won’t be careful… you will drown in the cold-hearted mystery of this devious land.

Drysoil Province
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/ced0187aa2d6b4d3e8cb485e9c5c74f03ee6778b.gif

And now for something completely different - the dry and barren scenery of Drysoil! Be careful, these rough steppes belong to the wild nations of orcs and ogres. They aren’t exactly known for their hospitality. In fact, their disposition towards outsiders can be rather… cruel.

Biomes Overhaul
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/3d2c44dbb4c8c038b5b02689473840b0e256beba.gif

Look at all these stunning biomes! Nature can be truly beautiful (and deadly), right? It’s a huge pleasure for us to announce that you will finally be able to experience Realms of Magic’s sandbox the way it was always meant to be experienced - with staggeringly beautiful and diverse biome for each and every province!

New tiers and armors
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/6e330d938077473fd66034474865ad3e03524bd5.gif

That’s right! Time for another edition of #fashionrealms! As always, new places to visit also mean brand new armors to acquire! We have over 30 new sets for you to choose from, some of them will drop from enemies, while others (such as Cobalt, Thorium or Adamant) you will be able to create from new types of crafting materials.

New boss and tier weapons
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/fe15236cbae3ceb6a63d54910b1e4637a7220ac4.png

Here’s a treat for the fans of chopping, hacking and slashing. We will also introduce many new weapons (some of them will drop from enemies, some of them you will have to craft). As we had previously established - Frostpath and Drysoil are mean places, however, you will have more than enough of “sharpy, pointy, stabby” gear to protect yourself with.

New enemy weapons
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/2b93f3161b7e679687b65e065589dc91c21d7ef4.png

Don't think that you will be the only one getting armed to the teeth. The foes (new and old ones) will also have a few tricks up their sleeves (remind me to Google whether or not plate armor actually has "sleeves"). Such as shiny swords, wide shields, heavy maces or sharp axes. Let the arms race begin!

New creatures
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/b9b29ff09e8846f199a4b886e74d9a714efed3d8.gif

So you don’t believe that the Old Kingdom can be challenging? You see this stuff up above? These vicious cyclops? These powerful ogres? These wild boars? They spell “d-a-n-g-e-r” for you! And the best/worst part about it? It’s just the tip of the iceberg! We have many new monsters for you to encounter and you better be on your A GAME, if you actually want to beat them!

NPC titles
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/230da96ae45acb9e84697d722032a3931c21df32.png

“Darn it! Where was that merchant? How am I supposed to recognize the blacksmith?” - if you had any of these thoughts during your previous playthroughs then we have something just for you. All important NPCs now have easily visible and readable titles above their heads. You won’t confuse merchants with blacksmiths ever again!

Changelog 0.10

Features

New Provinces

 Frostpath Province
 Drysoil Province
 New quests
 New locations

notes.title: Beta Update - Stonebridge
notes.content:
Citizens of the Old Kingdom! We understand that the king’s regulation about quarantine ruined holiday plans for many of you, however, it’s for your own good! Health is truly important and precious. And yet, if some of you would still like to make an official complaint - the gates of our magnificent capital city of Stonebridge will reopen soon! So join our newest beta and embark on another great adventure!


New locations
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/72f7330abbe3000df379418b7241b78174c8f260.gif

Stonebridge, with its vast size and walls filled to the brim with various characters, truly deserves the title of a capital city! In fact, it’s so big that it had to be divided into two separate districts! This beautifully designed location is “the place to be”, the heart and soul of the Old Kingdom. Visit it today and check out all of its beautifully designed houses, castles and cathedrals!

New armor sets
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/075b9a6a06c532e0967f74d0d92f3a6d8b0da830.png

Stonebridge is a brand new province that comes with some unique gear! Continue the eternal tradition of #fashionrealms and check some fresh armor sets (over 20 of them!!! ) such as - Thief, Assassin, Horned, Warlock or Improved Leather. We especially recommend the Assassin set in these trying times of quarantine as it seems to be the only set that properly protects the wearer’s face!

New map
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/e96122ad50adc8d1c0aa947b2f9b7060a7d60493.gif
Do not make that eye doctor appointment - your eyes are NOT deceiving you! Just look at all that life and diversity that our new map presents!  That's right, each and every province will now have its very own, distinctive look on the map and some of its elements are now be animated!

Join a guild!
We’ve always been saying that the Old Kingdom is a living, breathing world. It’s not only filled with colorful characters and interesting storylines - it’s also a home of various bands of people with their own agendas and purposes that you can join!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/a339d266946612d9f39375c03b72766c6e4cfa4b.png

The Temple is a religious cult worshipping the Old Gods (the dominant religion of the Old Kingdom). A perfect place for those of you who might be interested in weird rituals, hooded figures and omnipotent beings.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/aff6112ecfb1ca0bbb7231f2ef078a8e6840c6e4.png

The City Watch is the perfect place for all those battle-hardened knights and paladins of yours! It’s a military organization focused on keeping peace in Stonebridge and its surrounding areas (watch out - they always have permission to use force!).

Last but not least - the Winking Eye, a criminal organization gathering various thiefs, thugs and bandits! If you like to #getrichquickly or simply want to backstab someone - you might be a good fit.

New quests
Join ranks with the City Watch and try to restore law and order in times of crisis and despair. Ally yourself with the Temple and bring hope to those in need. Work for the Winking Eye and find yourself in the twilight zone of the so-called business entrepreneur. But most of all, find out what happened to the rulers of this land! 

New music tracks

notes.title: Beta for version 1.0 is coming! Time for a major overhaul!
notes.content:
The sheer amount of brand new additions and changes in this version is simply staggering! It could genuinely be compared to at least several major updates combined.

2019 was a calm before the storm. We’ve released two major updates: 0.6 - The Magic Update and 0.7 - The Caves Update. But the development of Realms of Magic hasn’t slowed down one bit, the pace actually increased as we were simultaneously working on both major updates and the massive 1.0 version.

This update aims to overhaul and improve the majority of the game's systems and content. All these features are interconnected - changing one thing requires modifying multiple others. Each major change required balancing other elements and that’s why we decided to release 1.0 as one massive update.

Without further ado, let’s see what kind of future awaits the Realms of Magic!

World Overhaul

The Map
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/79bb30cb6a75213f4e614aad590b2f653634cda7.png

The old world will die... drowned in the high seas of past updates... and a brand new one shall take its place! Most of the previous locations and quests have been moved and changed along with the multitude of new quests being added. The map itself has also changed.


Provinces
Travel beyond the horizon and discover 7 provinces that constitute the Old Kingdom. However, you will have to fight for your right to visit them, as they will gradually unlock with your progress. Why should you even care? Every province means unique enemies, creatures, caves and resources.


Remastered locations
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/81d5f32ef0a3a313d9c1357040f8521f9b43989c.gif

This update is not only about introducing the new but also enhancing the old. All locations in the game were drastically improved or even completely remade. All in order for them to look and play better. By the way, no more empty plains! Now when visiting a dungeon you get to it right away, without the need to run an actual marathon through forests to get there! #norunningforme


Remastered quests
We have not only changed how the Old Kingdom looks... but also what tasks you might encounter along your way. All quests are now more intricate, better written and provide you with improved dialogue options.


Stonebridge - Capital of the Old Kingdom
The Old Kingdom is a living, breathing world. However, it's quite hard to show its scale by making you visit smaller villages and settlements (we don't have anything against farmers, though!). But now it’s time to visit Stonebridge - the Capital City of the Old Kingdom. In fact, this place is so big that we had to split it into two different districts, as we couldn’t fit it in just one location (yep, it's that part where we brag a little)!


Main storyline
During your escapades through the seven provinces you will uncover various threats and dangers that loom over the innocent inhabitants of the Old Kingdom. Once uncovered... will you be strong and wise enough to stop them?


Guild questlines
During your journeys you will encounter four different guilds. Each guild has its own agenda with unique rewards for your help. Stonebridge is a serious city for serious people - you will have to side with at least one of the three guilds and prove your worth.

Join the Temple, a religious cult worshipping the Old Gods, the dominant religion in the Old Kingdom. 

Fill the ranks of the City Watch, a military organization keeping peace in Stonebridge city and its surroundings.

Align yourself with the Winking Eye, the criminal organization that tries to disguise itself as a trading company.

After you have proven yourself in one of these groups you will be able to join the Sellswords, a highly powerful guild employing renowned mercenaries from all corners of the Old Kingdom. Who knows... they might even play a major role in determining the fate of this realm. ;)


Combat Overhaul

New weapon types
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/939a827cc7182ea6075c216ae85c5e982cb6b045.png

Don't get us wrong, Swords, Axes and Maces (previously available weapon types) are great. They are pretty solid pieces of equipment that are necessary for your survival in the Old Kingdom. However, we also understand that different people have different tastes. Maybe you want to stab someone instead of slashing them? Maybe you want to keep your distance? And just maybe... you want your sword to be human-sized? No judgment here, and that's why Update 1.0 will introduce 5 new weapon types: Daggers, Spears and Heavy Swords, Heavy Axes and Heavy Maces.


Attack patterns
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/5bd3d01218f433b7e0dfc1474a32c46fc141bae6.gif

Previously weapon types differed from each other only on the visual level. This new update will introduce attack patterns for every type of arms. Weapons will now have their own, unique attack patterns that will allow you to strategize more and be better prepared for dangers to come.


New abilities 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/38c49282c18bc3510209d3044bec661678968d20.gif

Psst! Hey! Hey, man! You want some melee with that magic? That's right, each magic tree will receive one new ability that is a hybrid between melee/magic skills. These abilities will be using Stamina instead of Mana and will easily improve your mage build with some hybrid capabilities! #nerfthat


Overhauled skill trees
Every skill tree has been majorly overhauled. Our goal was to make each and every talent impactful and fun to explore (who knows, maybe one quest will even require you to win a new edition of the hit show "Old Kingdom Got Talent"?! <- nah, that's a lie... or is it?). Anyway, we removed some of the talents or merged them into one and several new ones were added.


New NPC AI
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/69fb04a9cf56fb0a1fa8b5320cc50a9c0ebeda10.gif

Watch out! NPC's are coming and they are ANGRY! All because we have improved their attack patterns. Each enemy type will behave differently and rely on various arsenal of attacks and skills. For example, orc brute will focus on slow but powerful attacks (they might be easier to dodge... but may the Old Gods help you, if some of those strikes reach you), while a roguish bandit will rather apply some sneaky-cheeky hit and run tactics.


Other minor changes
We’ve also made a multitude of smaller changes that will improve how combat in Realms of Magic feels. These tweaks include: reworking blocking and shield mechanics, reworking stamina costs for ability usage and changing the flow of movement in combat.


Sandbox Overhaul

Provinces and biomes
Current version of the game incorporates only two types of biomes, plains and forests. Update 1.0 will, once again, shake things up a bit. Each of the 7 provinces will have its own landscape filled with unique animals, monsters and resources. Plains and forests will now contain the same types of resources, however, forests will have more of them... but also will be much more dangerous to roam through - a treat for the fans of a classic high risk and high reward design.


Caves
Each province will also have its own cave system with another set of unique enemies, resources and treasures. In the current version of the game every location has the same types of caves with 3 different cave tiers. Update 1.0 will eliminate different cavern tiers within the same location, however, each of the 7 cave biomes will significantly differ from each other, both in terms of their visuals and content.


New creatures
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/ba5c2326b32d1628afd7ef8a4d118d540b89d9e8.gif

Remember when we wrote that NPCs are getting ANGRY with their new attack patterns? Well... don't forget about the monsters because their ranks are getting bigger by the minute! Update 1.0 will introduce over 15 new creatures. Everyone of them will have unique sprites, attack patterns, special abilities, combat parameters and loot.


Expanded professions
Creating new biomes, caves and creatures also means introducing new resources needed for crafting. That's why Blacksmithing, Leatherworking and Tailoring professions will receive the most significant increase in available recipes... just in time for the Old Kingdom's fashion show season!


Gear Overhaul

New tiers
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/94b886391c4b03b2e8868d34d0dcdfb7b5d814aa.png

New resources also mean new tiers of armor, weapons and tools. Blacksmithing will receive Adamant, Titanium, Demoncursed and Ebon tiers. Leatherworkers will be able to craft new items from Dark, Thick and Shadow Leather, while Tailors will get Cotton, Khandar and Zariot fabrics.


New armor sets
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/3c10c509bbdc1bcb67042089e0758b00b6166b9f.png

We also have some great news for all you fashion freaks out there! The total amount of armor sets will increase... significantly. Update 1.0 will provide you with around 130 different obtainable armor sets. Some of them will be crafted, some looted from enemies, others will need to be purchased from merchants, obtained as rewards for completing quests or simply found in randomly generated caves and secret locations. But more importantly - YOU WILL ALWAYS LOOK FLY! #fashionrealms


Unique weapons
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/ead4821a73ca180b4418a522a014b483ea40f1b7.png

For the fans of cutting, slashing and/or crushing - don't worry, we do remember about your destructive needs. Currently all weapons are crafted through Blacksmithing profession, however, Update 1.0 will introduce some brand new unique weapons that will be obtainable in other ways.


Special equipment parameters
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/107e1286e1a9320d03be10ccf1146edb1d18d73c.png

Alright, alright, we will admit it - currently the only difference in armor sets is the armor value. But we assure you that the gear will get waaaaaaaay more interesting. Armor sets will receive special parameters that will make every part of your gear unique and special in its own right. Here are some examples of said parameters: increased mana, increased melee damage, increased fire spell damage, increased health of summoned undead etc.


Improved Map Interface
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/bfc3d1cc2f6a82ea948e51915779bcc0bcffadc0.png

Along with the new map we’ve updated the map interface by vastly improving its behavior and adding several heavily requested features [because we DO appreciate your suggestions :)] such as the ability to add notes and markers on the map.


Secrets and Powerful Enemies
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/178ce2ba47cbc76368427f9b96e7f1f9690bb10d.png

Secrets are cool, right? Uncovering them is even better (even if you have to slain some big monsters along the way)! That's why each location will now include a number of secrets to discover and powerful enemies to slain. Secrets may contain Mysterious Essence, while powerful enemies will drop Powerful Essence. Combination of these powerful items will create the Potion of Knowledge, which will permanently grant you one talent point.


Profession Trainers
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/ca8f8078d7208b59a3f32a1e80dfbb098588934f.png

Let us tell you - the current job market of the Old Kingdom can be really capital "R" Rough! That's why some NPCs will now offer you training in various professions in exchange for gold. The higher your profession level, the higher the training cost. It will serve as a convenient way to speed up profession leveling while providing a valid gold sink for your precious finances. Come on, invest in your future!


Final Boss
An amazing storyline deserves a suitably big conclusion! That's why Realms of Magic shall culminate in an epic encounter with a truly powerful boss that will provide a major challenge to even the most powerful of characters.


New Tutorial
Once again, time for some honesty. The old Tutorial Dungeon was decent but rather stale and uneventful. We will be replacing it with a completely new tutorial. The goal of this new introduction is explaining basic controls as well as showing the best parts of the game from the get-go.


Balance
We’ve taken major steps to significantly improve the balance of the entire game. We’ve created a special tool that will be able to send us (with your permission!) anonymous data that will help us with balancing various elements of the game: combat difficulty, economy, character and profession experience curves, sandbox progression etc.


Minor Features

Location reset system
If you haven’t visited one of the sandbox locations for a while then you will have an option to reset it. Why even bother? This process will make all resources in the game truly infinite.


Improved dialogue window
The dialogue window has been increased and equipped with a bigger font. We’ve also made some changes that will cause dialogues to be more fluid and responsive.


Improved merchants
You will encounter more merchants during your journeys and you will find their stock to be much more varied and useful.


...and more!
There are just too many smaller tweaks and changes to simply list them all here but believe us that they will make Realms of Magic a much more POLISHED GAME.


Final Words

Beta
If you can’t wait to try the new version (can't blame you there :P) and want to help us with developing it, we have good news! In just a couple of weeks we will be releasing the first Beta version of Update 1.0! This version will include the first 3 out of 7 provinces and most new features in their WIP state.


Release date
When Update 1.0 is going to be released? The initial plan was to release it this Spring, however, due to the increased scope of the game, we decided to push back the release date to Summer of this year. What can we say... perfection needs time! ;)


Discord
If you want to participate in the Beta, you will be able to do so by joining our official Discord server:
https://discord.gg/9nS3sMb

We know that this post wasn't the shortest but huge thanks for sticking with us, we hope you are as excited about Update 1.0 as we are!

Your Polished Games Team

notes.title: Cave Update 0.7 was just released!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/98486926e6c6b4323d5b18418c0f7c5aa6cf4c0a.png

Every sandbox location now generates random caves for you to explore. Inside you will find new dangerous enemies and sweet loot guarded by them.

Currently random caves consist of three tiers, the deeper you go, the more powerful monsters you will encounter and the more valuable treasures you will find. To make caves prettier and easier to navigate we've added glowing crystals and mushrooms that light up surroundings.

To make getting out of caves easier we've made a big change - now you can travel from anywhere, you no longer need to reach edge of location or find a signpost to do so. We have also improved Mining profession, previously it only increased damage you do to blocks but now it will also increase the mining speed.

Please bear in mind that caves won't generate in locations you've visited before this update.

https://i.ibb.co/27VfP2Y/0-7-Gif-Caves.gif



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/1af87a9cb3384596b15d6728f5438162620c4f2f.png

In caves you will encounter two new creatures: Cave Kobolds and Mole Rats.

https://i.ibb.co/cv0D1mN/0-7-Gif-Kobold.gif

Cave Kobolds are stronger and nastier cousins of usual Kobolds. Similar to their weaker counterparts they use hit-and-run tactics but with one major difference: instead of trying to hit you from up-close they are throwing their daggers from distance, which makes them much harder to defeat.

https://i.ibb.co/pytCPwj/gif-molekat-min.gif

Similar to Cave Kobolds, the Mole Rats are more difficult variant of Giant Rats. Their special ability is that they will run away and regenerate when they are hurt. When you encounter one Mole Rat this ability may not appear that powerful but when need to fight several of them, then you could be easily overwhelmed.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/a5fa0f2fb8cbe7ba884cf08dbfa3eb959da07025.png

Three new Blacksmithing materials have been added: Mithril, Cobalt and Thorium. Mithril and Cobalt ores can be found deep in caves, while Thorium is an alloy of Mithril and Cobalt, similar to how Tin and Copper together make Bronze.

With each material you will be able to craft new and more powerful tools, weapons and armors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/f3f866f7419bf33bd8e31216d7b6f86792543b31.png



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/f24f99775edcfb290a95f12b267489f42c372153.png

We've overhauled color palettes for each race and streamlined character customization. Now color options for each category will only show if your character is actually using them, for example you won't see hair color if your character is bald.

Our goal was to make sure that each character created when you hit Randomize button will look good, which wasn't usually the case before. This overhaul will not only make creating new characters easier and more fun but will also make NPCs you encounter in your adventures look better, as majority of them have randomly generated appearance.

This feature will most likely make your character look slightly different, if you are not happy with new colors then please remember than you can visit the Witch in the top-right corner of the map to change your appearance.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/e27f41751c6f02b0f947adc691e4d14d56def834.gif



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31339861/139cf9e70f0a8dded1906ebff32337b9a69f64cb.png

notes.title: Roadmap for 2019
notes.content:
Dear Citizens of the Old Kingdom!

It’s been over a year since Realms of Magic has arrived on Steam in Early Access. Our Team keeps working hard on improving the game and we can’t wait to share with you the details about what’s coming to the Realms in 2019. 

We would greatly appreciate if you could read this post to the very end.

Game development is not a straightforward process. As you develop the game it evolves and changes and very often the final product is different than initial vision. We grew as developers over the years and thanks to your feedback and support we learned a lot about the game we want to deliver. That means the final shape of Realms of Magic will be slightly different than what was originally planned. But fear not! It will be even better, we know what we are doing, trust us ;)

But before we get to that, first we want to make a short summary of the most important features and changes implemented in Realms of Magic since Early Access began a year ago.


Summary of 2018

https://i.ibb.co/n8nbyQT/Animated-Summary.gif

Map size increased over 4 times!

31 new handmade locations
Over 40 new quests

Fire Magic
Husbandry profession
Trading profession
Racial abilities
Weather system
Holiday events
Witch - special vendor with many new tilesets
Obtainable mansions
New creatures
Farm system
Save system
Farming and Cooking overhaul
Improved character creation screen
Optimization
Dozens of quality of life improvements
Signposts
Sleeping
Bag sorting
Quick stack
Crafting interface improvements
Character statistics tab
Hide helmet option
and many more...
Hundreds of bug fixes

We are proud of what we've managed to achieve last year. The game is now much bigger and entertaining than it was when it initially launched. However, we are not done yet. Here is the plan on how we will make Realms of Magic fully complete.


New Roadmap

We are going to leave Early Access by the end of this year. Providing extensive, yet cohesive experience is our main goal. We believe that we will be able to do just that in a year.

We will release 3 big patches, each focused on different aspect of the game.


Patch v0.6 - Combat Update

New Magic Schools
Version 0.6 will feature not one, not two, but three new Magic Schools!
Combat Overhaul
We listened to your constructive feedback about combat feeling slow and clunky. We've addressed the issue and from now on it will be much more dynamic and satisfying.
New animations
Another heavily requested feature were new character animations. We remade most animations from scratch and now they look much more fluid and realistic.
Idle animations
Areas with NPCs will feel more alive and natural.
Potion Bar
You requested, we provide! You will now be able to quickly drink potions in a convenient way.
You can check out work in progress version of combat overhaul, new character animations, idle animations and potion bar on just released Beta version. You can learn how to participate on our Discord server: https://discord.gg/9nS3sMb

https://media.giphy.com/media/uipTnCgWbscDeEY3sf/giphy.gif


Patch v0.7 - Content Update [Beta] 

Randomly generated caves
Exploring sandbox locations will be much more interesting, exciting and rewarding.
New unique loot
Caves will contain tons of new items only found there.
New ores and tiers
You will be able to find new materials like Mythril, Adamant and Cobalt and craft new tools, weapons and armor with them.
New enemies
More for you to slay.

Patch v1.0 - World Overhaul [Full Release]

We started work on World Overhaul over half a year ago. We are changing the map layout, rebuilding every village and dungeon and rewriting every quest. The world as you know it will be no more - it will be replaced with a much better version of it. Because of that version 1.0 will require starting a new character. (You will be able to continue adventure on your old characters on 0.7 version of the game.)

Remastered villages, dungeons and quests
We remade every location and quest. Locations are looking much better and are more interesting to explore. Quests provide you with more dialogue options and choices.
New dungeons and quests
More dungeons to crawl and many new quests to complete.
Stonebridge - Capital City of the Old Kingdom
Huge central city filled with over a hundred new NPCs for you to meet. It will also feature two new music tracks.
New Biomes
Two new biomes to discover and explore: Mountains and Plagued Lands.
Improved map and interface
New beautiful map with quality of life improvements.
Progressive Boss Fight
Each time you defeat him he becomes even stronger, always providing you with a challenge.

What's after version 1.0?

We believe that after implementing all things listed above, Realms of Magic will feel like complete game. We will continue working on the game after leaving Early Access. However, scale of future development on Realms of Magic will depend on how successful the full release will be.

It is always sad and frustrating when you need to cut some features you really wanted to implement. Nevertheless, we want Realms of Magic to be the best game it could possibly be and more does not always mean better. We prefer to improve and polish what we know will work instead of tackling some of the huge features we are uncertain we could provide with quality standards we aim for.

If a feature you were looking forward to is not included on 1.0 roadmap it’s doesn’t necessarily mean that it won’t be implemented at some point in the future. It just means that it won’t be implemented in version 1.0. 

That is all we would like to say to you today. We are getting back to work. Cross your fingers for the team and once again we kindly thank you for all of your support!

As always, stay Awesome!

Your Polished Games Team

notes.title: The Future Ahead
notes.content:
Hey!

We want to let you know what we’ve been up to for the past several months. Right after we released version 0.3 we took a step back to analyze what we’ve already created and revisited our plans for this year.

Where are we now?

We’ve managed to achieve something we are really proud of - we’ve created a game that pulled in thousands of people for a really long time, dozens of players even spent more than one hundred hours in our game! Realms of Magic was played for a total of around 50 000 hours!

These numbers make us really happy, however they also motivate us to create something even greater - and this is what we want to focus on in the near future - creating better, more immersive and more satisfying experience. Instead of only adding new content to the game we also want to focus on improving some of the core gameplay mechanics that we feel we could do a better job on. That doesn’t mean that new content isn’t coming, in every major update we want to introduce something new and fresh for existing players.

Where are we going?

One of core mechanics that will be drastically overhauled is combat. Our goal is to create challenging and dynamic system that will not only be interesting on the mechanical side but will also be visually spectacular.

Another major aspect that will be improved is roleplaying, exploration and questing. We want our game to be a fully-fledged RPG, and in order to achieve that we will be improving the way we create quests and write dialogues - that means more choices, more consequences and more questlines.

A very important part of RPGs is character progression. We want leveling up and spending talents to be even more exciting. To do that we will be replacing majority of passive talents like increased HP or increased melee damage with classic stats like Strength or Endurance. Every level you will get several stat points and one talent point, which you will spend on talents that actually change the way you play.

One of the core elements that we want to improve is the world itself - we want it to feel like living, breathing world. Things like weather system, visual improvements, more alive NPCs and dynamic events are features that have a goal of making the world feel alive.

When on the subject of the world, we want to improve the way in which the world is presented to the player and how he is guided through it. We also want to revamp parts of the world that are in our opinion the weakest, especially the randomly generated ones. Mining and hunting/gathering would be much more interesting if you could find caves, structures and diverse random encounters.

We will be also revisiting some of the professions and adding many more recipes and tiers to them. We feel that several professions like Blacksmithing, Leatherworking or Tailoring feel a little lackluster compared to other professions such as Crafting or Cooking.

Plans for 2018

We want to deliver everything described above this year. Version 0.4 is coming in July and you can expect the patch preview next week.

Here is small tease of two features coming in version 0.4:
Racial abilities
Weather system
After version 0.4 we want to release two other major updates this year. Version 0.5 will focus on overhauling the world and quests. Version 0.6 will feature combat overhaul.

Official Realms of Magic Discord

To help you out find yourself in our growing Realms of Magic family we decided to launch an official Discord Channel. Feel free to share your thoughts and opinions and help us build something even bigger!

Join Discord Server by clicking the link below:
https://discord.gg/m3eDAqg

Discord channel is also the easiest way to contact with the Development Team to report bugs, post suggestions and ask questions. We will try to make it a place where you can easily find the answers for all your questions about Realms of Magic.

Beta tests

To make the game development process run faster and smoother we will be opening Open Beta Test Server. All players who would like to help with testing new, unpublished content will now have this opportunity. Unstable Version of Realms of Magic will be updated every Friday afternoon (GMT+1) with new gameplay elements and content. 9th of July is the planned date for beta tests launch. Please find out more information on a dedicated channel on RoM Discord.

That’s all we have to share for today. We hope that you are as excited for the future of Realms of Magic as we are!

Best regards,
Polished Games Team

notes.title: February Update
notes.content:
Hey! We wanted to let you know how the progress on version 0.3 is going. Initially we were aiming to release it in early February but unfortunately it will come a little later, current estimate is by the end of February. The delay is caused by increased scope of the patch, we decided to include more features, tweaks and quality of life improvements that we originally planned.

Bugfixes

One of the most important things for us are the bugfixes. We want to provide you with as stable and bugless experience as possible in Early Access. We can proudly say that the majority of already reported bugs will be fixed in 0.3 version.

Quality of life improvements

Another important thing are the quality of life improvements. The list of these improvements is quite big, so we won’t be listing all of them here. Several examples in 0.3 include backpack sorting button, quick stack button in containers and ability for crafting stations to use resources from nearby containers.

Announced features

Bugfixes and quality of life improvements aside, version 0.3 is first and foremost a content patch, so let’s get right into the new features.

We’ve already announced 6 new features but we would like to describe some of them in more detail. Previously announced features were:
Fire magic talent tree
Expanded Guidebook and achievements
Increased map size with new locations and quests
Stamina and Mana food recipes
Signpost system
Regenerating locations
 Fire magic talent tree

Let's start with the Fire talent tree, here is how it will look:
Currently it contains 50 talents total, which is made up from 35 unique talents. An average talent tree in current version contains only about 13 unique talents. We want to set a new standard of talent tree quality with Fire magic.
It will contain 5 spells in total, 4 combat and 1 utility
FireballDuh! What kind of fantasy RPG doesn’t have fireballs?
FlamesBasically a flamethrower
Burning RushIncreases your sprint speed, damage enemies on your path and leaves a trail of fire
FirelingsAfter you summon them they will fly around you and damage your enemies
Magic FireUtility, you will summon magic fire that will follow you and work as a torch, so you can use your second hand for casting spells or using weapons or shields instead of holding a torch
Fire magic will revolve around setting your enemies on fire and then spreading it
Expanded map

Another already announced feature we want to describe in more detail, is expanded world map. Let’s start with the size of the new map - because size really matters!

Here you can compare the map size in versions 0.1, 0.2 and 0.3:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31339861/65e20cb6b428df6a3cf400498db726b4330e9476.png

As you can see, the map size in version 0.3 will be more than twice as big!
New map will add over 20 new handmade locations for you to explore.

Some of these locations will include new quests which will triple the amount of quests available in the game!

New features

Now let’s get into previously unannounced features for the upcoming update:
Farm locationIn one of the new locations you will help a farmer with creating his farm. If you bring him seeds of different plants, then in return he will plant those seeds, allow you to harvest the crops and replant them after you’ve collected them.
Trading professionYou will level it up by buying and selling items from merchants. The higher the level, the better prices you will get.
Sleeping systemYou will be able to sleep in bed. We will be also increasing day duration to 1 hour from 30 minutes. The goal is the let players conveniently skip the night and explore during the day.
Different armor typesCurrently there is no difference between heavy armor, light armor and clothes - except for the armor value which makes heavy armor always better. New system will add an offset to equipping heavier armors, as they will increase mana cost for casting spells and stamina costs for performing attacks. However heavy armors won’t impact stamina cost on exploration skills like sprinting or jumping.
Stats tabs in Character windowYou will finally be able to see your stats like stamina regeneration, movement speed or armor damage reduction.
Reworked building previewPlacing items was a little awkward sometimes but no longer!
Hide helmet optionVery requested feature which we are happy to deliver.

What makes you the most excited about version 0.3? Let us know!

Regenerating locations
 Fire magic talent tree

Let's start with the Fire talent tree, here is how it will look:
Currently it contains 50 talents total, which is made up from 35 unique talents. An average talent tree in current version contains only about 13 unique talents. We want to set a new standard of talent tree quality with Fire magic.
It will contain 5 spells in total, 4 combat and 1 utility
FireballDuh! What kind of fantasy RPG doesn’t have fireballs?
FlamesBasically a flamethrower
Burning RushIncreases your sprint speed, damage enemies on your path and leaves a trail of fire
FirelingsAfter you summon them they will fly around you and damage your enemies
Magic FireUtility, you will summon magic fire that will follow you and work as a torch, so you can use your second hand for casting spells or using weapons or shields instead of holding a torch
Fire magic will revolve around setting your enemies on fire and then spreading it
Expanded map

Another already announced feature we want to describe in more detail, is expanded world map. Let’s start with the size of the new map - because size really matters!

Here you can compare the map size in versions 0.1, 0.2 and 0.3:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31339861/65e20cb6b428df6a3cf400498db726b4330e9476.png

As you can see, the map size in version 0.3 will be more than twice as big!
New map will add over 20 new handmade locations for you to explore.

Some of these locations will include new quests which will triple the amount of quests available in the game!

New features

Now let’s get into previously unannounced features for the upcoming update:
Farm locationIn one of the new locations you will help a farmer with creating his farm. If you bring him seeds of different plants, then in return he will plant those seeds, allow you to harvest the crops and replant them after you’ve collected them.
Trading professionYou will level it up by buying and selling items from merchants. The higher the level, the better prices you will get.
Sleeping systemYou will be able to sleep in bed. We will be also increasing day duration to 1 hour from 30 minutes. The goal is the let players conveniently skip the night and explore during the day.
Different armor typesCurrently there is no difference between heavy armor, light armor and clothes - except for the armor value which makes heavy armor always better. New system will add an offset to equipping heavier armors, as they will increase mana cost for casting spells and stamina costs for performing attacks. However heavy armors won’t impact stamina cost on exploration skills like sprinting or jumping.
Stats tabs in Character windowYou will finally be able to see your stats like stamina regeneration, movement speed or armor damage reduction.
Reworked building previewPlacing items was a little awkward sometimes but no longer!
Hide helmet optionVery requested feature which we are happy to deliver.

What makes you the most excited about version 0.3? Let us know!

notes.title: 2018 Update
notes.content:
Hey! We hope you had wonderful Christmas and New Year's Eve!

It’s been one month after first release of Realms of Magic. We would like to sum it up and also let you know what will be coming next, both in 2018 and years after it.

First of all, we would like to thank our community for amazing support we got from you. The warm reception we got from you exceeded our wildest expectations and it really motivates us to work even harder and make the game much better.

Special thanks to everyone who took their time to report bugs, offer suggestions, write reviews and answer other people questions. It’s extremely helpful so keep up the good work! Unfortunately, we can’t respond to every post, but we promise you that we are reading every single one of them.

What’s next?

We will release 0.2.2 after this weekend, it will contain several bugfixes and will also turn off holiday event, so it’s last the chance to grab festive decorations from Edbert the Merchant and holiday tree from Obos the Innkeeper.

We also already started work on 0.3 update. This update will be quite bigger than 0.2 update and it should arrive in early February. Here is the list of planned features, however please bear in mind that some of them can be postponed to later version if we won’t be able to make them in time.

Version 0.3 - Magic Update
As the update name suggests, we are finally adding magic to Realms of Magic, specifically - the Fire talent tree.
Improved and expanded Guidebook with many new tasks and integration with Steam Achievements. The goal of new Guidebook will be to guide players through all of the current content instead of being just an extended tutorial.
Increased map size with new dungeons and a new quest hub village. We are planning to increase World Map size in most major updates.
New food recipes. Current recipes are based on meat and provide you with Health Points buff. New recipes will provide Stamina Points buff (based on vegetables) and Mana Points buff (based on fruits and sweets).
Signpost system. Signposts will be placed in locations like villages and you will be able to craft them and place them yourself. They have two functions. The first one is that they will allow traveling to different locations when you are near them. The second is that when you will be traveling to location with an activated signpost, then you will appear near it, instead of the edge of the location.
Probably the most requested feature - locations will regenerate if not visited for a certain period of time. Every player made structures will still be there but all creatures and plants will respawn. We hear you!

Roadmap

We’ve just published requested Roadmap, you can check it out here: Roadmap

notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31339861/88ecef1f4bc5d014646896b641447fac37edd25e.png

Hey! The very first content update to Realms of Magic is now live!

Features:

[FEATURE] Holiday Event

Holiday Event will last for two weeks
All NPCs in the game are wearing Winter Hats
You can turn in 5 Winter Hats to Edbert the Merchant for one of three decorative items
You can complete simple quest for Oswald the Innkeeper and he will reward you with Festive Tree

[FEATURE] Increased World Map size by 50%, scroll the map to see new locations
[FEATURE] 7 new dungeons (for simplicity, we refer to all handmade locations with hostile enemies as dungeons, including locations like bandit camps)
[FEATURE] Added several quests in Woodbury (Obos, Moriana, Glug, Edbert)
[FEATURE] Two new creatures: Kobolds and Imps
[FEATURE] Random NPCs now spawn in wilderness (does not apply to already visited locations)
[FEATURE] Added recipes for crafting stairs
[FEATURE] Candlesticks, Candelabras and Chandeliers now have fire effects and give light
[FEATURE] Ability to remove corpses with "Remove" button

Changes:

[CHANGE] Copper now spawns more often (this change does not apply to already visited locations, if you are planning on doing some mining, then we recommend doing it on previously unvisited location)
[CHANGE] Tilled dirt stays tilled for longer time
[CHANGE] Grass spreads faster
[CHANGE] Armor now gives about 20% more damage reduction
[CHANGE] Power Attack now deals 150% base damage instead of 125%
[CHANGE] One-handed damage talents now increase damage by 15% instead of 10%
[CHANGE] Block talents now give 15 Block instead of 10
[CHANGE] Spin attack now randomizes damage per spin instead of once
[CHANGE] Wolves damage has been reduced to 18 from 20
[CHANGE] Boars damage has been reduced to 32 from 35
[CHANGE] Increased Barrel armor to 25 from 10
[CHANGE] Decreased crafting time for Platforms
[CHANGE] Changed crafting experience for sacks and small sacks so that big sacks give more experience than the small ones
[CHANGE] Better Emblems and Banners now have a higher price
[CHANGE] Reduced time it takes for fruits to grow on fruit trees
[CHANGE] Changed Oak tree texture

Bugfixes:

[BUG] Fixed bug that could prevent players from completing quest in Hardsoil Bulwark
[BUG] Fixed bug that allowed player to pause the game in order to skip moving to respawn location after death
[BUG] Fixed bug that gave Farming experience for picking up placed fruits and vegetables
[BUG] Fixed bug that allowed players to get inventory icons as items
[BUG] Fixed Oaken Chest animation
[BUG] Fixed several recipes that incorrectly used Pine instead of Oak
[BUG] Fixed Green Glass Cup and Brown Glass Cup items
[BUG] Iron Legplates and Barrel no longer hide incorrect body parts
[BUG] Fixed typos in Morgon and Gustav Dirk dialogues
[BUG] Fixed typo in Hardsoil Bulwark journal entry
[BUG] Fixed Pine Platform icon
[BUG] Fixed rendering of selection on map when zoomed in

We've worked hard for these past two weeks since the Early Access release to give you something new to do during holidays. Even though we've spent most of the time since launch on bugfixing, we are quite happy with amount of new features and content this update adds to the game, we hope you will like it too!

There probably won't be any patches next week (unless something critical happens) because most of us are taking a week off to spent holidays with our families. We will be back in 2018 with more bugfixes, polish and content!

Have a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!
